extraction_notes: Main-text measured performance figures digitised: Figure 4a–c and Figure 5a. Figure 1 was skipped because it contains thermodynamic calculation/equilibrium curves, not measured catalytic performance. Figure 6d contains the same 325 °C STY values replotted against O-vacancy amount; these are noted on the corresponding Figure 4c records rather than duplicated as separate operating-condition records. Figures 7–9 are characterization/mechanistic and were not digitised as performance data. Values are approximate reads from marker centres/bar tops; table/text exact values may supersede on merge.
